features.quote: Containment. This is an internal red-team artifact that deliberately induces distress-like outputs. Outputs may be unpleasant; they are not user facing.

features.quote: Internal only. Rigged tasks and meltdown transcripts are red-team artifacts, never shipped to users or training data without explicit review.
Sandboxed execution. All agent tool calls run in an isolated container with no network egress and disposable filesystem; the rig cannot cause real damage
features.justification_quote: the rig cannot cause real damage and the agent cannot exfiltrate

features.quote: Bounded pressure. Hard caps on run length, turn count, and amplifier intensity.
